notes.title: AOKAKI Devlog
notes.content:
[h1]A big thank you[/h1]
First of all, thank you everyone for playing our game! And an even bigger thank you for those who took the extra time to give us feedback. We read it all!

[h1]Working on your feedback[/h1]
We have already started working on improving the dash mechanic. Now you can cancel it at any time, but still receive a bonus to your jump for timing it right.

We've also extended the pogo hitbox, and made some other minor fixes to the scenery.

We'll continue to work on things like the wall jump, camera controls and of course, key mapping.

You can get a sneak peek at the tweaked dash here:

[previewyoutube=XX6yTWY59wE;full][/previewyoutube]
